scripts.polaris: sh -lc 'if [ "$1" = "--" ]; then shift; fi; exec ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/polaris.ts "$@"' --
scripts.test:smoke: sh -lc 'set -a; [ -f ../../.env.test ] && . ../../.env.test; set +a; NODE_ENV=test ./node_modules/.bin/tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/polaris-pairing-url.test.ts tests/polaris-runtime-observer.test.ts tests/polaris-web-clerk-config.test.ts'
scripts.test:full: sh -lc 'set -a; [ -f ../../.env.test ] && . ../../.env.test; set +a; NODE_ENV=test ./node_modules/.bin/tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 $(find tests -type f -name "*.test.ts" ! -path "tests/live-auth/*" | sort)'
